title: Currency or fund code and validity
reason:
Provisional Phase 1 concept only. Fresh Phase 2 must decide existing-meaning reuse, equivalence and distinctions. It is not a canonical definition or accepted source mapping.

Phase 2 UNRESOLVED: Money needs currency, amount role and time basis. Core money-amount requires a stated unit; most demo numeric columns lack established currency. Currency entity differs from code, fund and territory assignment. FX requires directed pair, quote kind and observation/publication date. Employees salary currency is unknown. No country-to-transaction-currency inference; no cross-currency totals. Preserve binary-float conversion limits. Definition gap: the candidate combines source roles or lacks a sufficiently bounded reusable definition and binding domain. Retain the candidate; do not infer absence from literal query results.
